notes.title: version 1.2i! some new surprises!
notes.notes: added some new foes and fixed some small bugs, small level edits here and there.  Prepping for bigger polish edits and more additions!

notes.title: small bugfix
notes.notes: code edit for potential bug, regarding cheat code logic.

notes.title: performance improvement and level edits
notes.notes: Major performance improvement made!  Levels with a high number of 'brick' tiles now run much better.  The game should overall run very smooth now.  Some small edits to certain levels fix/tweak some minor issues.

notes.title: Xbox controller support tweaks
notes.notes: The game should now pause when opening any Xbox or Steam overlay, either by selecting an app via the system overlay or alt tabbing out of the game, in general when the game looses main focus to another app or window it should pause the game and bring up the pause menu.

notes.title: Difficulty Tweaks and Firelogic Fix...
notes.notes:
Players can now have up to 7 extra lives, it was only 3 previously.  There is a small chance that upon death, foes will drop an extra life pickup.  Now all brick type tiles have a one in thirty chance to spawn a white gem when destroyed(happens more often than you might think).  These changes will help to ease player frustration and enable them to progress further into the game.  PermaDeath is still active but now, with more extra lives available and more gem units available NOT DYING is more manageable.  

Found and fixed a huge oversight with the players charge shot at UP-RIGHT-DIAGONAL not doing anything, now it fires as expected.

Small edits to some levels to better balance the difficulty.

notes.title: End Game Content added!
notes.notes:
Added additional end game content!  Ultra Gemma awaits you!  As well as more enemies added to most levels, for an extra challenge.

Fixed a bug where the game locks up after viewing the controls screen(pressing i in game) Thanks MB!

Additional smaller movement issues fixed.

Ultra Gemma is an Ultra, nearly overpowered, overtly lewder version of Gemma, with a much higher max gem count(3 times as much as normal Gemma), faster gem recharge rate, better defence, much faster and longer punches and far superior fire power, with a low gem unit cost, as well as an extended defensive double jump, oh and she has 99 lives to play with too!  Face strife and make her yours!

After completing all 52 levels for the first time, you will be able to choose Ultra Gemma when starting a new game, subsequent play-throughs will include additional randomized foes strewn throughout most of the levels, waiting to break your soul... Select either Gemma or Ultra Gemma and show the machines what steel really is!! 

Additional updates coming soon...
